info.name: UKFSS LA API test pack
info.description:
Tests the two ways a sample reaches the laboratory from your system:

A. Complete samples: saved through the API and sent to the lab through the API.
B. Incomplete samples: saved through the API as drafts, then completed and sent by an officer in the UKFSS Portal.

Folder C covers correcting a draft through the API instead, and a few edge cases. Folder D checks the samples once test results have been returned.

Set apiKey in the collection variables, then run the folders in order. Requests in a folder depend on the ones before them. Samples are sent to PATST, the UKFSS Test Laboratory. Nothing sent on the Test environment reaches a real laboratory.

exec: // Sample date: one hour ago, local time, no seconds. UKFSS accepts dates from 30 days ago to 7 days ahead.

variable.description: Test environment. Never point this collection at Live.
Full office code: authority code + office.
Your own identifier for the sampling officer.
UKFSS Test Laboratory, recommended for testing.

item.name: 0. Setup checks
item.description: Confirms the key works and the codes in the collection variables are valid for your authority. Run these first.

item.name: 0.1 Key works and covers our authority

request.description: Lists the authorities this key can submit for. Expect your authority code in the list.

item.name: 0.2 Office code is set up

request.description: Lists your authority's offices. authorityOfficeCode must be one of these, in full (e.g. 999HQ).

item.name: A. Complete sample, sent to the lab through the API
item.description: A sample with every required field passes validation (VALIDATED) and can be sent to the lab straight from your system, with no Portal step.

item.name: A1 Save a complete sample

exec: // Fresh LA reference each run so samples are easy to find in the Portal.

request.description: Expect success true and status VALIDATED. Stores fsId and fsReference for the next steps.

item.name: A2 Read it back: VALIDATED

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); const r = Array.isArray(j) ? j[0] : j;

request.description: The saved sample is ready to send.

item.name: A3 It is listed as ready to send

exec: pm.test("Sample listed as ready to send", () => pm.expect(refs).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("completeRef")));

request.description: candidate-samples lists every VALIDATED sample awaiting export.

item.name: A4 Send it to the lab

exec: pm.test("Our sample is in the batch", () => pm.expect(j.sampleCodes).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("completeRef")));

request.description: Exports the sample to the lab in the collection variables. laboratoryCode must match the one on the sample.

item.name: A5 Read it back: EXPORTED

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); const r = Array.isArray(j) ? j[0] : j;

request.description: The sample now belongs to the lab.

item.name: A6 Sending it again is refused (409)

exec: pm.test("Our sample is listed as the failure", () => pm.expect(j.failures.map(f => f.sampleReference)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("completeRef")));

request.description: A sample can only be sent once. The whole batch is refused and nothing is exported.

item.name: B. Incomplete sample, corrected and sent in the Portal
item.description: A sample missing required fields is still saved, as a draft (ENTERED), with the problems listed. It can't be sent through the API. An officer finds it in the Portal under Sample Browser > All drafts, completes it, saves it and sends it with Export to lab. B5 and B6 are run after those Portal steps, to show your system can see the outcome.

item.name: B1 Save an incomplete sample

exec: // Fresh LA reference each run so samples are easy to find in the Portal.
pm.test("Sample was still saved, as a draft (ENTERED)", () => pm.expect(j.data.fsStatusCode).to.eql("ENTERED"));

request.description: Premises type, batch number and food category are left empty. Expect success false, status ENTERED and an error for each.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); const r = Array.isArray(j) ? j[0] : j;

item.name: B6 After sending it from the Portal: EXPORTED

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); const r = Array.isArray(j) ? j[0] : j;

request.description: MANUAL STEP FIRST: in Sample Browser > Ready to send, tick the sample and click Export to lab. Then run this request.

item.description: Useful if your system can correct a draft itself rather than leaving it to the Portal. Run after folder A.

request.description: Same as B1, a new draft.

item.name: D. Results from the Test Laboratory
item.description: Run after MacLaren West has returned test results for your PATST samples (ask support). Results usually show within a few minutes. The API reports the sample as COMPLETE; the result values are in the Portal (Sample Management) and in the Portal's MIS Export.
